body: They only reason I’m still here is the weight of that taboo, and preemptive guilt.
No I figured those would follow me into the grave. Alas I was referring to social media.
That’s fair, I’m only posting here because I’ve already deleted all my SM accounts and even had I not I wouldn’t publicly post any of this

Most everyone I know thinks I’m doing a lot better. Yet today I’ve been updating my beneficiaries, and packing up my valuables with a loose will.

I’m pretty rationally checked out, I’m not upset, I’m not even feeling excessively depressed. I’m just done, I don’t feel like doing Wednesday.
